name: Cashew nutshell oil
description: Cashew nutshell oil (CAS 8007-24-7 ), also known commercially as cashew nutshell liquid (CNSL), is a natural phenolic oil extracted from the shell of the cashew nut. It functions as a reactive bio-based raw material and processing aid across coatings, adhesives, friction materials, and polymer systems. In coatings and varnishes, CNSL-derived resins provide heat resistance and chemical durability, making them a preferred bio-based alternative to synthetic phenolic resins. Friction material manufacturers use it as a binder resin component where controlled thermal performance is required. Brake pad and clutch lining producers rely on this material for its unique friction-modifying properties. In rubber compounding and tire manufacturing, it acts as a processing aid and plasticizer that improves flow without compromising cure characteristics. Adhesive and sealant formulators use it as a reactive modifier to adjust viscosity and enhance cross-link density in phenolic and epoxy systems. This versatile oil is supplied as a dark viscous liquid in drums and IBC containers for industrial use. Technical-grade CNSL is the standard commercial form, with natural and technical variants available. The heat-treated technical version features a different phenolic composition relevant to downstream reactivity and specific chemical synthesis. Refined and distilled grades are available for applications requiring reduced color or controlled cardanol content. These high-purity options ensure consistency in specialized manufacturing processes where aesthetic or precise chemical parameters are critical. The material meets rigorous industrial specifications to ensure performance in demanding environments.
